name: Ulam
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The line of Saul the king is traced through Jonathan, Merib-baal, Micah, and on to Azel, whose six sons close the chapter, and the sons of Ulam who were mighty men of valor, archers, with many sons.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
